name: Daily Easy Apply Digest
author: Haseeb
summary: Builds a concise morning digest of mid-level backend roles from LinkedIn and Indeed, ranked against a resume.
starterPrompt: Create today's shortlist of mid-level backend roles. Rank the strongest matches first and explain the fit in one sentence each.
usageNote: Job listings change quickly. Open each original listing and confirm fit, location, and availability before applying.
